summary: Dated summary of the verification runs recorded for MVP-001 slices S1 to S11, per slice and evidence level (Packet section 5). It restates recorded results with their sources; it records no new run, declares no integration complete and is not a release or production-readiness record.
rules: Only facts present in the slice PR descriptions as summarized for the readiness pack (S1 to S7), the S8, S9 and S10 PR descriptions, the git history and, for S11, the records the Builder keeps outside the repository (pass and correction reports, final validation, L5 and restore run reports) are used; the latter are marked 'Builder record'.
Commit and merge times are git commit times converted to whole-second UTC. A run date or start instant is given only where the source states one; otherwise the field says not stated.
Proof check identifiers repeat across proofs; a check is always cited with its proof file.
No provider identifier, host, address, key, account name or personal identity is recorded.

independent_review_ps_a6.findings: DB-1 (medium, reproduced) the Legal Hold rule missed resources the house resource coverage reports held; DB-2 Complaint Cases on the requester's Referrals were not counted; DB-3 the break-glass guard allowed approval changes on a revoked grant and an approval instant ahead of the clock, and the approval check lacked approved_at >= requested_at; DB-4 dual-role Users were admitted to client data-request commands at aal1; proof gaps BG-5 (deactivated or suspended requester after approval) and DR-5 (counterparty paths); APP-1 (medium) application readers measured UTF-16 units where the database counts characters; APP-2 no page refresh after approval or revocation; APP-3 no database ceiling on code lists (now 500); APP-4 a statement hint making a promise (now a neutral hint); APP-5 the label Decision (now Recorded decision); APP-6 wrong refusal for a caller without an active Staff Profile; test gaps PSA6-7 (column names) and untested revoke outcomes
independent_review_ps_a6.outcome: All findings accepted and corrected in d9d115110b1049dd637e3a2c99ab45b58012cc78; against the uncorrected migrations the amended PS-A6 proof fails BG-7, DR-1, DR-5 and CV-1
independent_review_ps_a6.external_review: None (no ChatGPT or Independent Backup review)

independent_check_d9d1151.by: A separate review agent (disposable cluster, all 76 migrations)
findings: Medium, reproduced and fixed in 2a1b94f: data_request_legal_hold_applies evaluated resource_under_legal_hold once per Resource of the requester; with 5,000 documents and 200 unreleased holds this took 2.4 to 2.6 s per evaluation, run twice per decision while it held the SHARE lock on legal_holds, and a concurrent hold placement with lock_timeout 3s failed with 55P03. Fix: the Resource scopes are gathered once and matched against the holds in one pass, with coverage unchanged. New proof DR-7
Low, fixed in 2a1b94f: the break-glass approval and revocation outcome slot depended on client script; it now shows the server-rendered outcome before hydration; L1 PSA6-9 extended

Low, assessed as not a defect: an upload committed concurrently with a deletion decision can make a counterparty user hold cover the client only after the decision, which is equivalent to the decision coming first; PS-A6 section 3 rule 5 governs holds at decision time

Informational, no change: the database owner can write approval and revocation in one statement (the result reads revoked, no access), and a revoked_at in the future is accepted for the owner only; no API role or definer path does either
Low, already listed: dual-role Users at aal1 see an empty privacy list and a denied submission, with no step-up hint (optional enhancement)

Nothing found on: request_slot_starts (4,200 randomized cases across 16 time zones and DST transitions, 0 mismatches against the bookability reference; ACL, owner and volatility unchanged); withinCharacters against char_length; the notification_caller admission; the test amendments (no assertion removed or loosened)
independent_check_d9d1151.external_review: None (no ChatGPT or Independent Backup review)
